view_title: TRUSS T1, TRUSS T2, TRUSS T3, TRUSS T4
warnings: All truss members are one section, printed 'rectangular tube Ø-100x50x1.7 mm.' (four leaders per truss) — designation RHS, print kept in printed_as.

Mark conflict, decided: the T3 elevation labels the member at its apex 'T6' and the T4 elevation labels its far support 'T5'. No T5 or T6 exists on S-03, S-04 or the A-09/A-10 sections (which show T1-T4 only). By position (S-04) the member at T3's apex is T4 and T4's far support is T3 — the plan marks win (more sheets); the printed T5/T6 are kept in supports_printed_as / note and flagged.

Panel chains under the elevations carry no grid bubbles, so they stay on these elements (panel_lengths_printed_as) rather than becoming grid ticks. T1/T3 spans 3.50 + 3.50 and T4's 2.50 agree with the grid (1-2-3 and C-D).
